scenes.text: On Halloween twenty fifteen, an asteroid shaped like a giant skull flew past Earth.
Its name is twenty fifteen T B one forty five, and it's about six hundred meters wide.
It passed a little farther away than the Moon.
Radar images showed dark patches that looked just like eye sockets and a nose.
Scientists think it's actually a dead comet that has lost most of its ice.
Space didn't plan it, but the timing was perfect.
What's the spookiest thing you've seen in space?

title: A skull-shaped asteroid flew past Earth on Halloween 💀
caption: On Oct 31, 2015, asteroid 2015 TB145 passed just beyond the Moon's distance. Radar images made it look like a skull, and scientists think it's probably a dead comet. 💀
